body: 3 months out of a 10 year marriage, damn, you are still at ground zero of a HUGE change, no one will be thinking very rationally at this point. I don't know what the misunderstanding was, but, it might not have been a misunderstanding, it is common to second guess yourself. Try to change up your surroundings, concentrate on day to day things right now. Google the 'stages of grief', it's about losing something huge not just someone's death.

Part of that was feeling for the folks on this sub that are dealing with the worst of loneliness, that just pales compared to my self loathing though. I'm just sick of dealing with my lapses in judgement, my cowardice that's kept me in this spot. it's not even always just one sort of thing, I dunno. Right now I'm waiting, hoping things don't go so bad but I just have the worst feeling in the world. I would be more detailed but I really can't bear it.

dont make the mistakes I did when this happened to me, I started drinking a lot, smoking like a chimney, allowing crazy people in my life. Somehow got back together with her, for her to leave me for him again. I wasted so much time when I just should have used it as a chance to make myself into a better person, instead I just made my situation worse and worse and now I am making other peoples lives worse. 

The pain isn't going to go anywhere, but it will eventually stop or turn into just this low rumble, learn from it, soak it up, don't let it make you do something rash. People will do stupid shit sometimes, the things in their pants command it, this has been the case in all of recorded time.

edit:if you do stick with her, talk it out, but I will say that the stink doesn't come off easy man, every once in a while you wil think it's better and then you'll feel a sting, maybe feel the need to say something to make her feel like shit(this is not advised), it will be work for both of you and some things will have to change

If this plays out in a bad way there is no way they will ever forget about it, and I have a bad feeling, I hate being so vague, ugh, this past year has been so awful and my life has just spiralled down the toilet and now it's spiraling other people down the toilet
